IP Source Group Resource Add Source IP Group
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/ipSourceGroups

Adds a new IP source group.

Note: This endpoint can only add an IPv4 source address group. User-defined groups for IPv6 addresses are currently not supported.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

A unique identifier of the source IP address group.

name
string

The name of the source IP address group.

ipAddresses
string[]

Source IP addresses added to the group.

description
string

The description of the source IP address group.

isNonEditable
boolean

If set to true, the source IP address group is non-editable. This field is applicable only to predefined IP address groups, which cannot be modified.
